title: Let other devices on your network use the model
description: Makes Ollama listen on one of this machine's network addresses instead of only on itself. Ollama has no password: anything that can reach that address can use it.

bind.description: Address Ollama listens on. 127.0.0.1 means only this machine (and the app, through SSH).

contextLength.description: How much conversation the model keeps in view, in tokens.

keepAlive.description: How long a model stays loaded after its last use.

firewallCidr.description: If a firewall (ufw) is active, the network allowed to reach port 11434.

steps.title: Point Ollama at the chosen address
steps.why: Rewrites llmwizard's settings file with the new address.
steps.skipIf:
want=$(printf '%s\n' \
    '# Written by llmwizard. Your own settings belong in override.conf, which wins over this file.' \
    '[Service]' \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_HOST=$P_bind\"" \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=$P_contextLength\"" \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=$P_keepAlive\"")
[ "$(cat /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/10-llmwizard.conf 2>/dev/null)" = "$want" ]
steps.run:
want=$(printf '%s\n' \
    '# Written by llmwizard. Your own settings belong in override.conf, which wins over this file.' \
    '[Service]' \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_HOST=$P_bind\"" \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=$P_contextLength\"" \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=$P_keepAlive\"")
mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d
tmp=$(mktemp)
printf '%s\n' "$want" > "$tmp"
install -o0 -g0 -m644 "$tmp" /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/10-llmwizard.conf
rm -f "$tmp"
touch "$P_J/restart-needed"
echo "Settings written."

steps.title: Allow the model's port through the firewall, from your network only
steps.why: The firewall is on, so without a rule nothing could connect. The rule is limited to your network.
steps.run: ufw allow from "$P_firewallCidr" to any port 11434 proto tcp comment llmwizard
steps.undo: ufw delete allow from "$P_firewallCidr" to any port 11434 proto tcp || true

steps.title: Restart Ollama
steps.why: Ollama reads its address when it starts. This unloads any loaded model.
steps.run:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart ollama
rm -f "$P_J/restart-needed"
steps.verify:
case "$P_bind" in 0.0.0.0:*) api="127.0.0.1:${P_bind##*:}";; *) api="$P_bind";; esac
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do curl -fsS -m 2 "http://$api/api/version" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done
exit 1
